notes.title: Version 1.19
notes.content:
Improved ladder handling. 
Getting on to ladders should be a lot easier

 Improved analogue stick handling. 
This is also related to ladders , dead zone when on ladders has been increased so that you are less likely to accidentally fall off.
Code has also been modified so that you are at less of a disadvantage doing long jumps when using an analogue stick.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.12a
notes.content:
-Fix for issue where a Level time leader board could get corrupted.
-Fix for incorrect Display Settings menu title
-Using 'Password' for user name is no longer Offensive
-Fix for option menu navigation issue
-Addition of simplified 'Pixel Perfect' option, this just locks the game screen to the biggest pixel Perfect resolution it can have based on the size of window, or screen in fullscreen mode
-Rationalised options, all options where applicable now show current state.

notes.title: Version 1.12
notes.content:
- Addition of 3 ‘Hard Core Achievements'

- Controller support improved. Fixed issues with configuring Xbox controller, now possible to map Xbox’s D-Pad. This will have fixed issues with other controllers too

- Controller buttons, such as Start, can now be assigned to bring up pause menu

- Assigning an analogue control to a digital input gives the analogue control a digital response

- Optional camera filter effects added, selectable from the Options and Pause menus

- Jump now allowed after falling/sliding off ledge

- Temporary invincibility added after being hit by an enemy

- Collected Fruit now shown on level select screen

- Machine intro information now displayed when completing a machine and being automatically taken to the next without having to go back to the menus

- Added information about double jumps to initial instructions

- Machine descriptions updated to include some missing processor speeds

- Some other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Todays Update
notes.content:
We are working on an update with some additional features and improvements which will be due end of next week.
In the meantime here is an interim build addressing a number of small issues that have come to light.

Fix for potential loss of level/game times. possibly just a Linux issue, but now updated for all platforms just in case.

Fix for issues caused by an incompatible system locale.

Fix for issue with bubble re-spawns.

Fix for issue with vehicle jumping.
